integrity: The stated theorem and formulas were algebraically proved and checked against exact finite-state and matrix calculations. Self-review only; no independent audit, external certification, or independent verification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to synchronous neighbor sums in characteristic two, to products of complete graphs with at least one odd and one even coordinate size. Existing uniform-Hamming modular matrix methods are precursors; undocumented historical equivalence is possible. The numerical checks are finite and the all-parameter result follows from the proof.
title: Mixed-parity Hamming products: exact Jordan and relaxation laws for neighbor parity
